name: io.github.instinctagentai/gulf-open-data
description: Free Gulf open data: World Bank GCC indicators and data.gov.qa search, with source and licence.

tools.name: gulf_indicator
tools.description: Official World Bank indicator values (GDP, inflation, population, unemployment, etc.) for GCC countries (Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman), with Arabic and English names, source, licence (CC BY 4.0) and retrieval date.

indicator.description: World Bank indicator code, e.g. NY.GDP.MKTP.CD. Use list_indicators.

countries.description: ISO2 codes, default all six: QA SA AE KW BH OM

tools.name: gulf_country_snapshot
tools.description: Latest value of every supported indicator for one GCC country, in Arabic and English, with source and licence.

country.description: ISO2: QA SA AE KW BH OM

tools.name: list_indicators
tools.description: List supported GCC indicators and countries with Arabic and English names.

tools.name: qatar_open_data_search
tools.description: Search the official State of Qatar Open Data portal (data.gov.qa, about 2,000 datasets, CC BY) by keyword in English or Arabic. Returns titles in both languages, publisher, licence and link.

tools.name: qatar_open_data_records
tools.description: Fetch rows from one Qatar Open Data dataset by dataset_id (from qatar_open_data_search), with publisher, licence, attribution and dates.
